title: Compatible evolution of existing Framework and Smart Components

ownership.simai/ui-source: Authoritative Core, Component and Smart sources.
ownership.simai/ui-doc: Component documentation, live examples and documentation tracking.
ownership.simai/docara: Documentation consumer and example integration; not a CSS defect workaround.
ownership.simai/ai-codex-skill-sf5: Canonical component design method; no global installation changes in this goal.

requirements: Review every registered component and classify all extra shipped directories without silently excluding supported first-party visual blocks.
Review all Smart dependencies; reuse the base visual contract instead of duplicating styles.
Fix proven defects in semantic tokens, typography, geometry, focus, states, indicators and public attributes without breaking existing API.
Keep native focus and accessibility semantics; use focus-visible and appropriate inset or outer geometry.
Use real scenarios, not mandatory uniform surface modifiers or dividers.
Keep live examples, source contracts and local builds synchronized; verify changed behavior in a browser.
invariants: Preserve existing package identities, dependency graph, public compatibility and ownership.
Prefer semantic tokens; body text uses body typography; compact controls and large surfaces use their respective radius roles.
Keep existing correct implementation, third-party boundaries, unrelated dirty changes and verified published build.
No new components or dependencies; no hand edits to generated distributions.
completion: All corpus entries reviewed, zero unresolved required defects, tests and local builds verified, source-faithful examples and browser evidence complete.
